name: Moneys Creek

lines.name: Moneys Creek (beach basin to the causeway)
lines.limitSrc: causeway with tide gates (The Causeway road); the lagoon behind is only tidal while the gates are open

M.name: Mouth, Kellys Beach (≈ Burnett Heads −3 min)
M.src: No MSQ place at Bargara: interpolated between Bundaberg (Burnett Heads) (standard port, 7.8 km N, HW/LW 0, ratio 1.00) and MSQ Elliott River Entrance (19 km S, HW/LW −9 min, ratio 1.05) — open coast, estimate

M.name: Causeway (sea side, est.)
M.src: Basin behind the beach bar: highs ≈ 5 min later and 0.05 m lower than the beach (assumed); lows held at the perched basin level 0.75 m AHD (QLD LiDAR water surface) because the bar (1.16 m) stops it draining to sea level

landmarks.name: Mouth / Kellys Beach
landmarks.note: sand bar onto the beach; council moves sand to open it before summer

landmarks.name: Swimming basin
landmarks.note: patrolled swimming hole (closed while the gates run)

landmarks.name: Moneys Creek causeway (tide gates)
landmarks.note: road 2.5 m AHD; lagoon behind ≈ 0.95 m AHD (LiDAR); strong suction at the pipes — keep clear

confidence.why: no gauge or MSQ place at Bargara: tide interpolated between Burnett Heads and Elliott River Entrance; basin and causeway behaviour estimated from LiDAR — benchmark me

causeway.name: Moneys Creek causeway
causeway.thrSrc: estimated: lagoon water level 0.95 m AHD from QLD LiDAR (flow runs in above it, out below it while the gates are open)
causeway.locSrc: estimated: narrowest gap between the lagoon and the beach basin on The Causeway road (OSM + Esri imagery); exact gate position not mapped

gates.src: Bundaberg Regional Council, Moneys Creek Causeway Gate Operation Guidelines 2026 (guide only, subject to change)

sources: Geometry: trace on Esri World Imagery; OpenStreetMap water areas and The Causeway road (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL)
Heights: QLD Government LiDAR DEM (QldDem elevation service, CC BY 4.0), m AHD
Tides: Bundaberg (Burnett Heads) harmonics fitted to MSQ 2026 predictions (data.qld.gov.au, CC-BY 4.0); MSQ 2025 Tidal Planes (Elliott River Entrance) for the offset
Gate timetable: Bundaberg Regional Council (bundaberg.qld.gov.au, Our beaches)
